name: Dettifoss Deep
author: Frej Bjon
tagline: A songwriting drone synth for the FM-1
description: Chords over an evolving drone: progressions played one-handed on latching keys, shaped by a few live macros. In development, forked from Niagara Drift.
credits: Forked from Niagara Drift by Evan Yerburgh, itself built from FoMni by Charles Vestal and Felucca's platform by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments), with fm1-base's screen reader and flash checks.
